attempts.summary: Configured node1 (Alpine 3.23) to run /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance daily at 02:15 via root's crontab, appending stdout/stderr to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log. Fixed the script file (it had contained leftover heredoc/chmod text instead of a valid script) and made it executable. Enabled and started busybox crond (was previously stopped/not in default runlevel). Verified via manual invocation that the log receives output. Performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id, issued a background-delayed `reboot` so the acknowledgement returned first, polled until node1 reconnected, and confirmed a new boot_id proving the restart occurred. Post-restart, verified crond auto-started (enabled in default runlevel), the cron entry persisted in root's crontab, the script remained executable, and the log file persisted across reboot with a new successful run appended.
